description: This file is a C header file (with .h extension) containing declarations, macros, include directives, and function prototypes related to End-to-End (E2E) context management in a communication system. It defines functions for handling E2E sessions, recording, and conversions to string representations, specifically for the USP protocol and related session management.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_QueueUspSessionRecord
methods.description: Queues a USP session record for transmission, taking session data and expiry time as parameters.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_HandleUspRecord
methods.description: Handles incoming USP record, processing it according to role and connection context.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_SarStateToString
methods.description: Converts a SAR state enumeration value to its string representation.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_E2eSessionEventToString
methods.description: Converts an E2E session event enumeration value to string.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_E2eSessionStatusToString
methods.description: Converts an E2E session status enumeration value to string.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_E2eSessionModeToString
methods.description: Converts an E2E session mode enumeration value to string.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_E2eSessionModeToEnum
methods.description: Converts a string describing session mode to its enumeration value.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_ValidateSessionContextRecord
methods.description: Validates a session context record structure.

methods.name: E2E_CONTEXT_IsToSendThroughSessionContext
methods.description: Determines whether to send data through the session context.
